code_review.description: Exact Function-scoped operations for an initial code review.

resolve_function.description: Resolve Function nodes with exactly the supplied qualified_name.
resolve_function.cypher:
MATCH (target:Function)
WHERE target.qualified_name = $qualified_name
RETURN target.qualified_name AS qualified_name,
       target.file_path AS file_path,
       target.line_number AS line_number
ORDER BY qualified_name, file_path, line_number

direct_callers.description: Return Function nodes with a direct Function-to-Function CALLS edge to the target Function.
direct_callers.cypher:
MATCH (caller:Function)-[:CALLS]->(target:Function)
WHERE target.qualified_name = $qualified_name
RETURN DISTINCT caller.qualified_name AS qualified_name,
                caller.file_path AS file_path,
                caller.line_number AS line_number
ORDER BY qualified_name, file_path, line_number

affected_tests.description: Return test Function nodes reaching the target Function through CALLS paths of length 1..5; this is not comprehensive impact analysis.
affected_tests.cypher:
MATCH (test:Function)-[:CALLS*1..5]->(target:Function)
WHERE target.qualified_name = $qualified_name
  AND test.is_test = true
RETURN DISTINCT test.qualified_name AS qualified_name,
                test.file_path AS file_path,
                test.line_number AS line_number
ORDER BY qualified_name, file_path, line_number
